title: Grilled Canadian Salmon with Minari Slaw
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring grilled salmon, paired with a refreshing minari slaw. This recipe is gluten-free and perfect for a light lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Minari leaves
ingredients.notes: Also known as shiso or perilla leaves

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Rinse the salmon fillet and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the salmon with salt and black pepper.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, prepare the minari slaw by mixing the minari leaves with pineapple wedges and a squeeze of lime juice.
To serve, place the grilled salmon on a plate and top with the minari slaw.
